policies.title: Botswana live eVisa API visa-free cohort
policies.summary: Botswana's operational eVisa nationality dictionary directly marks nine remaining ordinary-passport nationalities as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to a valid ordinary passport for a short visitor journey; admission, permitted stay, sufficient funds, onward travel and other border conditions remain.
The live nationality dictionary and per-country checker were replayed on 26 August 2026; each listed nationality returned VisaNotRequired Y and the no-visa checker branch.

unresolved.reason: The live checker directly says a visa is required, but the generic online application surface does not establish whether an approved ordinary visitor document is electronically issued or a consular advance visa; the imported eVisa label remains unverified.
Macao has no entry in the live nationality dictionary and the checker returns only that the country does not exist, which is not a visa outcome or a recognition decision.

The live API marks a Holy See entry visa-free, while other current Botswana material uses Vatican City inconsistently; no official source maps the API label unambiguously to the catalog's ordinary Vatican passport.

Kosovo has no entry in the live nationality dictionary and the checker returns only that the country does not exist; no current direct source establishes recognition, document handling or a visitor-visa route.
